details: Eval(n) | Go, Gin, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, Zustand, TanStack, Mar 2025 – Present

Docker Compose and deployed on Kubernetes, ensuring consistent environments.
• Designed and implemented scalable RESTful APIs in Go (Gin) with clear contracts and modular architecture,
incorporating structured error handling, and secure RBAC permissions IAM for multi-tenant access control.
• Developed frontend features using React + TypeScript (TanStack Router/Query, Zustand, Zod, shadcn/ui),
integrating efficiently with backend APIs to maintain data consistency and improve user experience across workflows.
• Built and integrated an observability stack using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, enabling distributed tracing

details: JobsnProfiles | React, Golang, Express, Python, MySQL, Redux, Material UI, AWS, REST APIs Feb 2022 – Mar 2025
• JobsnProfiles is a full-stack hiring platform serving employers, placement agencies, and job seekers in the US, enabling
end-to-end recruitment workflows at scale.
• Architected a responsive React.js + Redux front-end with Material UI components, improving rendering performance
and UI consistency; integrated third-party job listing and resume APIs for real-time data synchronization.
• Worked in AI-powered resume parser in Python leveraging NLP techniques to extract and structure candidate data
(skills, experience, education), significantly improving automation accuracy in candidate screening pipelines.
• Designed RESTful APIs in Golang for user authentication, resume retrieval, and job listing updates; documented all
